Code architecture

bin/oci.dart                command line: import, new, set, pack add, design, analyze, check, validate,
                            export, bom and schema for .oci.json projects, one or many at a time, and
                            mcp, the Model Context Protocol server (bin/src/oci_mcp_io.dart: its root
                            folder, the isolate of each call, stdio)

                              transition), Scobey, Manning
      minor_losses.dart       fitting K, equivalent length, curve h = K·Q^n + C
      emitter.dart            q = k·H^x, wetted radius, fit to a data-sheet table, pressure window, overlap CU

Design decisions

  • Pure Dart engine. lib/core does not import Flutter, so it runs in the Web Worker, in the isolate, in dart run (tools and the command line) and in fast tests. The interface only builds requests and shows results.
  • One controller per project. ProjectController holds the project, the selection, the camera, the undo stack (entity snapshots), the spatial index and the calculation state. Every edit goes through mutate, which takes the snapshot, marks the project dirty, invalidates results and the index, notifies the interface and schedules the autosave.
  • Calculation off the thread. The project is serialised to the worker; the worker returns the results and the resized entities; an edit counter discards results of a project that changed while it was being calculated.
  • Spatial index. STR-packed R-tree rebuilt on every edit; painting queries only the visible window, and selection, snap and window selection query the index (microsecond queries with tens of thousands of entities).
  • Drawing on screen. The canvas keeps its drawing between frames (SceneCache): it is recorded again only when something it shows changes (an edit, the selection, the view, the base map, the results), so moving the cursor repaints only the snap marker, the tool preview and the item under the cursor over a picture of the scene. A scene that takes long to draw follows a pan or a zoom as a moved picture and is drawn sharp once the view rests. The painter gathers its drawing calls by paint (a few hundred calls for tens of thousands of items) and leaves out vertices closer than a pixel; lines no wider than a device pixel are drawn as hairlines and wider ones segment by segment (in the browser a wide stroked path is rasterised on the CPU), and a view packed with linework on a high-density screen draws its 1 px lines one device pixel wide. The status bar alone listens to the cursor coordinates, so the window is not rebuilt on every move.
  • Own formats in pure Dart. Readers and writers of DWG, PDF (with its fonts and text shaping), XLSX, SHP, GeoTIFF, LAS, IFC etc. do not depend on native libraries, which keeps the app 100 % web.
  • Centralised texts. All interface strings are keys of i18n.dart, with the Portuguese, English and Spanish texts compiled in and the other 17 languages in the packs of assets/i18n; the engine returns codes (velocity_exceeded:e12) that the interface translates. Every test file fails when the interface asks for a key the table does not have (test/flutter_test_config.dart), which would otherwise show the key itself on screen.
  • The AI uses the program, not a copy of it. The assistant's tools are thin wrappers over the controller and the engine, every change goes through mutate (one undo group per answer), and a coverage map routes every user-reachable function to a tool, an operation, a command or a setting. The six companies sit behind one interface (llm.dart), with the format conversion in one place (llm_formats.dart) and one agent loop; the request code takes the HTTP exchange as a parameter, so the tests run it against scripted fakes.
